description:
Get perp funding rate and open interest history. Returns a perpetual future's funding rate and open interest over a
configurable lookback window, sampled at a configurable resolution.
Both series come from the same venue snapshot row, so a caller reading
them together never compares values sampled at different times.

`funding_rate` is the venue's hourly rate as a decimal fraction, so
`0.0000125` is 0.00125% per hour. `open_interest` is a coin count of the
base asset (`35984.2` for BTC), not a USD notional.

See the [Time Window & Resolution](#section/Time-Window-and-Resolution)
section for the format of `window` and `resolution`.

asset_id.description: Backend asset ID. Mutually exclusive with `symbol`: exactly one of the two is required, and naming both is a 400.

resolution.description: Bucket size (e.g. `5m`, `1h`, `1d`). Must be at least `1h` for windows over `1d`.

symbol.description: Perp symbol to fetch the snapshot series for (e.g. `BTC`).

name: get_perp_market_history
